reviews.text: Luciana and her staff are excellent! Definitely a top-notch job, and the dog was comfortable and not even scared when I picked him up!

I took my Labrador to be groomed for the first time, and it was great. In fact, as soon as I came back to pick her up, the owner advised me to have her right paw examined because it was swollen and painful.
As soon as I left, I went straight to the vet, who gave me painkillers because it looked like a lump.
Thank you so much. See you next time.

Clean, fragrant dog with a well-groomed coat!
Best value for money in Milan!

I booked an appointment two months in advance for my West Highland White Terrier puppy, specifying from the start that I wanted a real stripping, not a simple grooming.

I know that stripping is a long, technical, and demanding job, and I gladly accepted the wait because it's the only correct method for managing a terrier's coat.
Unfortunately, upon collection, I was told it had been done... but the result speaks for itself: the dog was only cut with scissors, and his fur is now wavy, soft, and messy, as happens when the natural texture is damaged.

No area was actually stripped. I feel cheated, because I waited weeks for a technical job that was never done, but was still faked and declared as done.

For those familiar with the breed, it's clear that the coat has now been compromised and will need to be rebuilt with time and patience.

I ask only for honesty and professionalism, especially when working with young animals and breeds with specific needs.
Rating: 10!! The stripping was done very well, the dog comes out smelling good, with shiny, soft fur. The girls are super kind.
Fantastic place, our dog usually doesn't like water and doesn't like being washed, he feels completely at home and is treated very well
Great as always! I've been grooming my dachshund here for at least 7 years.

My two Scottish Terriers came out groomed as they should be. A warm welcome, attentive care for the dogs, and a thorough explanation of the work done by Mrs. Luciana. The quality justifies the price. Dog Model will have two more clients.
Competent and reliable, now a habit 🐕 …
The girls were helpful and patient, even with a client who seemed to be headed to the gallows every time he went to the groomer. The results were excellent.

I was deeply disappointed with my experience at this dog grooming shop. Initially, when the shop opened, I found the owner extremely kind and helpful. However, my last visit was anything but pleasant. After leaving my dog ​​on a leash for over two hours, I was shocked to discover that the price for a simple haircut on my dog's legs and backside was off-price and decidedly excessive. Not only did I pay significantly more than previous rates, but the level of courtesy and customer service was also completely lacking. It was a disappointing experience, and I cannot recommend this shop to anyone looking for quality service and respectful treatment of their pets.

The best place in Milan for 360-degree care for your furry friend.
The girls are super kind and super professional.
I DEFINITELY recommend them.
